text: 中国财政部发行91天期债券，规模300亿元，发行利率1.0842%，边际利率1.1746%，预期1.0000%，投标倍数3.94倍，边际倍数11.52倍； 中国财政部发行182天期债券，规模600亿元，发行利率1.1410%，边际利率1.1984%，预期1.1100%，投标倍数3.14倍，边际倍数6.66倍； 中国财政部发行20年期债券，规模240亿元，发行利率2.0991%，预期2.1000%，投标倍数10.47倍，边际倍数1.52倍。
text_en: China's Ministry of Finance issued 91-day bonds, 30 billion yuan scale, issuance yield 1.0842%, marginal yield 1.1746%, expected 1.0000%, bid-to-cover 3.94x, marginal cover 11.52x; issued 182-day bonds, 60 billion yuan scale, issuance yield 1.1410%, marginal yield 1.1984%, expected 1.1100%, bid-to-cover 3.14x, marginal cover 6.66x; issued 20-year bonds, 24 billion yuan scale, issuance yield 2.0991%, expected 2.1000%, bid-to-cover 10.47x, marginal cover 1.52x.
